Three things that follow directly from the data:

1. Prioritize P4 (materiality) and P5 (do not over-claim) first.
They have the lowest compliance and the highest impact on 
ratio credibility. Everything else in your report can be 
excellent — if these two are missing, the ratio is unreliable.

2. Compare your adjustment factors to the empirical distribution.
Free tool built from 247 reports with extractable data:
https://lnkd.in/eWnGtjhw

3. Reframe the ratio conversation with funders.
A compliant process produces a lower ratio than a non-compliant 
one. Practitioners who do the work rigorously should be rewarded 
for reporting more conservative numbers — not penalized.

Full paper: https://lnkd.in/ezDhzyX9
